A broad single square glass opening with slim matte graphite pressure-hull flange, recessed steel lip, black rubber gasket and eight small countersunk fasteners. No crossbars. The glass occupies most of the square. Straight front-facing upright wall insert with minimal upper bevel; flush inset architecture, no projecting sill. Detailed hand-painted industrial game art matching the previously shown BrineSpace window and wall references: controlled muted tones, crisp construction, restrained diffuse shading, no coarse pixel grid or photographic grit. Opaque deep dark teal glass shows a broad painted rocky seabed with sparse kelp and layered underwater depth; no water surface or sky. Full square asset centered with generous true transparent margin. No surrounding wall, text, glow, chrome glare, lamps or rust.
